title: After a host move, sessions recorded on another host give their role slots back
description: The registry holds a live master session and three worker sessions recorded on host 'old' while the install runs on host 'new'. One loop cycle ends all four with a reason naming both hosts, launches the master role in the same cycle, frees the worker slots, and master status names no 'cannot launch' line for the master role. A session recorded on this host with a live process is untouched (GY-3346).
